# variant_sample_two_distinct_inner_axes

Pins the streaming planner's full-suffix variant-label emission so
``matrix_eval``'s ``--variant-sample > 1`` mode does not collapse two
inner-axis-distinct variants onto the same short ``<comp>-<opt>``
label.

When a cell samples > 1 variant per ``(comp, opt)`` slot, the same
``(gcc15, O2)`` pair can appear with different inner axes — flag_set,
hardening, sanitizer, march. Before the fix at
``template_graph/streaming/dispatch.py:155`` the planner stored only
``<comp>-<opt>`` in ``VariantArray.variants``; the second sample
silently overwrote the first in ``variant_lookup`` and one variant
was lost from the descriptor list. The fix composes the full sidecar
form ``<binary>__<arch>__<comp>-<opt>-<flag>-<hardening>-san-<san>-march-<march>``
which is also the key shape the matrix_eval sidecar emits, so
``variant_lookup`` collisions can no longer happen between distinct
inner-axis samples.

**Tree**: 1 binary ``hello`` × 1 cell (x86_64, gcc15, O2) × 2 variants:
  - baseline ``baseline-default-san-off-march-default`` (the canonical
    matrix root variant the calibration pair handles cleanly).
  - sampled ``unroll-fortify-san-asan-march-x86_64_v3`` (every inner
    axis differs from baseline — the sample-mode variant).

Both variants have one ``hello-2.12.drv`` child each, with DISTINCT
hashes per variant (matches what a per-variant compile would produce
when the inner axes differ enough to invalidate the cache). The
``hello-2.12.drv`` role collapses to ``hello.drv`` post-version-strip,
so the calibration pair walks them under a single ``common`` bucket
and classifies the node ``variant_specific`` (distinct hashes across
the pair).

**Expected**:
  - ``build_variant_count == 2`` — both labels survive descriptor
    emission.
  - ``per_variant_toolchain_task`` — both variants wire to the SAME
    bare ``x86_64-linux__x86_64__gcc15`` task_id (carried in the
    cross-phase ``build_compilers_depends_on`` field) because
    ``parse_variant_path`` returns the same ``(arch, comp)`` pair for
    both drvs, and that drives ``_variant_toolchain_dep`` independently
    of the inner axes.

Test convention: the harness will load ``toolchain_task_ids.json``
(empty here, the per-variant toolchain wiring is gated by phase-1
having emitted the canonical id) and treat the empty dict as "skip
the toolchain-wire check" OR thread an injected
``{"<hash>-wrapped-compiler-suit.drv": "x86_64-linux__x86_64__gcc15"}``
+ ``known_task_ids`` containing the expected id. The
``per_variant_toolchain_task`` value above lists what
``_variant_toolchain_dep`` will return WHEN ``x86_64-linux__x86_64__gcc15``
is in ``known_task_ids`` (validated by the prototype).

**variant_lookup.json convention**: list-of-records,
``[{"key": [arch, label], "value": {...}}, ...]``. Both records have
the same arch (``x86_64``) and ``(comp, opt) = (gcc15, O2)`` but
distinct ``label`` values that carry the full inner-axis suffix.

**tree.txt provenance**: generated by
``template_graph.tests.test_streaming.fixtures.render_tree`` (seeds
0/1/2 for root/toolchain/matrix, 10/20 for the two variant roots,
110/120 for the per-variant ``hello-2.12.drv`` children).
